name: md-ops
description: A local-first Markdown operations workspace with a browser UI, API, and MCP server.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run setup:api && npm --prefix site ci
scripts.setup:ci: npm ci && npm run setup:api && npm --prefix site ci
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:ui && npm run build:mcp
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:operations
scripts.verify: npm run test:operations && ./scripts/prepare-ui-bundle.sh && npm run test:api && npm run build:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:mcp && npm run build:mcp && npm --prefix site run build
